problem: The running total is labelled "5 s after firmware", which reads as if 5 s pass after firmware finishes. The 5 s is the cumulative time at the end of the bootloader (firmware plus bootloader), so the wording can mislead a reader.
fix: step 2: Add them in boot order, keeping a running total: 2 s + 3 s = 5 s so far (end of bootloader); 5 s + 4 s = 9 s (end of kernel load); 9 s + 1 s = 10 s (login prompt).
